erwin:article.title: Commander
erwin:article.text: {{Meta Support Unit}} {{Story Meta Unit}} {{Raid Meta Unit}} =='''Overview'''== '''Commander''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary }} unit. He is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]]. ==Stats Overview== {{Tower_Infobox |caption1="My Soldiers Push Forward, My Solders Scream Out! My Soldiers RAAAGEEEEEE!" |caption2="Onward Christian Soldiers!" }}{{Main Stats}} Note that he has a maximum of 3 summon (called ''Survey Corps Member'') in the map per 1 Commander placed. His buff stacks with [[Blossom]] which makes the Physical damage buff reach up to 35-110%. ==Active Ability: Dedicate your hearts!== [[File:0F75D44E-3835-4BCC-90B6-4AC10158526B.jpg|left|thumb|80x80px]] When activated, Commander increases the {{Damage Type|Physical}} damage stats of units in his range by 25%. If he buffs other Commanders in his range, their ability is going to buff by 56% to 95 to 100%. The buff lasts for 30 seconds and the ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds. =="Infinite" Buff Guide== Commander '''MUST BE CURSED''' with '''+SPA''' curse in order for this to work. '''ATTACK SPEED FROM STATS DO NOT MATTER AND DO NOT AFFECT ABILITY COOLDOWN.''' The percent shouldn't really matter, but depending on how high or low the increase might effect how long the loop will last. (Not exactly sure on the specifics yet.) Guide: *1. Place 4 Commander's, doesn't really matter the position as long as all they are all in each others range. *2. Activate the first Commander's ability, then wait 4-5 seconds. (Using an auto-clicker set to a 4-5 second interval can help if you are having trouble timing it.) *3. Activate a second Commander's ability. Then wait for the 25% buff to disappear. *4. As soon as the 25% disappears, immediately activate your third Commander's ability, then wait until the 56% buff to disappear. *5. As soon as the 56% disappears, immediately activate the your fourth Commander's ability. After this they should all buff to 95% then loop 100% for a while, this loop isn't truly infinite since over time the ability will slowly desync, but if timed right can last for over 50 rounds, which is long enough for pretty much every situation. ==Selling== Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades. ==Trivia== * At the time [[Wind Dragon]] is added in the game, he was nerfed to the point he can only buff Physical damage units. * As of Update 14: ** His ability is now available at Upgrade 0 instead of Upgrade 3. ** He used to have maximum of 3 units per person. It's adjusted to 6 (global). This is the same thing inflicted to [[Wenda]]. *Chaining his buffs allows him to buff all Physical units by 100%, although to consistently do this you may need to apply curses to his SPA to get this to a full uptime, this also applies to [[Wenda]]. {{Unit Navigation}}__NOTOC____NOEDITSECTION__ [[Category:Legendary Units]]

aki_evolved:article.text:
{{Unobtainable Unit|Update 12 - My Hero Academia Update}}
==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} {{LU}}. He can only be obtained by evolving [[Curse]].

{{EvolutionTable}}

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1=“Enemies are enemies… we’re only using them. I have no intention of getting friendly with one.”
|caption2="The one who killed my family and the one who killed my buddy are still alive. So, what would I be quitting for?"
|image1={{PAGENAME}}.png
|image2={{PAGENAME}} Shiny.png
}}{{Main Stats}}

==Contract: Kon==
[[File:ContractKonIcon.png|thumb|left]]
Curse (Contract) gains 50% more damage from his Curse Devil Form but he gains 50% more SPA. He now has a bigger AOE from his previous form which lets him attack more enemies, but costing his ability to do multi-hit.

His Kon form is Recommended for crowd-control or killing a huge wave of enemies.

==Contract: Curse Devil==
[[File:ContractCDIcon.png|thumb|left]]
Curse (Contract) applies a curse stack every time he lands a critical hit on an enemy. If he lands 4 Curse Stacks, he would deal an extra 200% more damage to enemies (true damage) . He is a multihit unit so he can attack multiple times in 1 attack (no dmg multipliers) significantly increasing his Curse Stack every attack. The  [[Relics|{{RarityColor|Mythic|Nail}} Relic]] can heavily boost his critical chance easily increasing his curse stack and activating his 200% true damage boost (true damage) but his AoE is smaller compared to his Contract: Kon, Form.

His Curse Devil form is recommended for slaying bosses, break down heavily shielded enemies or high HP enemy units.

mahoraga:article.title: Divine General
mahoraga:article.text:
=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. Hе can only be obtained by upgrading [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]] to when he gets the Ritual skill, and using the Ritual active skill. The player will have the ability to control what mode {{PAGENAME}} fights in, these modes being: Attack, Defend, and Boss.

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1=""
|caption2=""
|attack_type=|damage_type=Dark|tower_type=|seconds_per_attack=|range=|upgrade_levels=|deployment_cost=|total_cost=|damage=|image1=|image2=}}

==Attacks==
<tabber>
|-|Scream=
In '''Defend Mode''', {{PAGENAME}} uses a Full AOE attack to scream at his current location. This attack deals about '''0.51x''' the value of the '''Damage''' stat or equally '''1.66x''' the value of the '''Summon''' stat of the [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]] used to summon {{PAGENAME}}. This attack triggers at a rate of about '''1x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. His '''Jump''' attack triggers at a rate of about '''2x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. This attack targets the '''First''' enemy on the map.

|-|Car Toss=
In '''Attack Mode''', {{PAGENAME}} uses a Circle AOE attack to throw a car at enemies. This attack deals '''1.25x''' the amount of damage of his '''Scream''' attack. This attack triggers at a rate of about '''1x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. His '''Jump''' attack triggers at a rate of about '''2x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. This attack targets the '''First''' enemy on the map.

|-|Slash=
In '''Boss Mode''', {{PAGENAME}} uses a Single Target attack to teleport to an enemy and slash them. This attack deals '''2.5x''' the amount of damage of his '''Scream''' attack. This attack triggers at a rate of about '''0.5x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. His '''Jump''' attack triggers at a rate of about '''1.5x''' the SPA of [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]]. This attack targets the '''Strongest''' enemy on the map.

|-|Jump=
Used in '''all Modes''', {{PAGENAME}} uses a Circle AOE attack to disappear from the map and land on a targeted enemy (targeting varies based on mode). This attack deals '''2x''' the amount of damage of his '''Scream''' attack. This attack's rate seems to vary depending on the mode.
</tabber>

==Adaption==
{{PAGENAME}} has the ability to adapt every time he kills an enemy or assists in killing an enemy. The player will be able to choose an adaptation (one of three) every 50 takedowns. {{PAGENAME}} becomes fully adapted once all adaptations have been unlocked (150 total takedowns).

<tabber>
|-|Divine Wings=
'''Divine Wings''' turns {{PAGENAME}} '''hybrid'''. Allowing {{PAGENAME}} to target and attack '''flying enemies'''.

|-|Heavenly Force=
'''Heavenly Force''' adds the '''[[Effects#Knockback|Knockback]]''' effect to his '''Scream''' and '''Jump''' attacks.

|-|Adapted Slash=
'''Adapted Slash''' grants a '''+100% Crit Rate''' while using his '''Slash''' attack.
</tabber>

==Trivia==
*{{PAGENAME}} is currently bugged, whenever it is summoned it will always be its shiny version.

*{{PAGENAME}} is the first summon unit that can walk while attacking and does not die when colliding with another unit.

*Although {{PAGENAME}}'s Scream attack damage depends on the '''Summon''' value of the [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]] used to summon {{PAGENAME}}, all of his other attacks' damage seemingly scales off of his Scream attack instead, if you have buffs applied to the [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]] they do not carry over to Divine General, instead Divine General only takes the buffless dmg

*{{PAGENAME}} is able to be buffed by limit breaks, applying a 30% damage boost to all his attacks. When applied with the damage boost [[Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)]] gains, he can gain a x1.69 damage boost from max limit break.

*{{PAGENAME}} can be buffed by [[Elfy (Sylph)]], [[Wind Dragon]], [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]], [[Zombie (Risen)]], and [[Blossom]] if {{PAGENAME}} is within their range.

*{{PAGENAME}} wont be buffed by [[Zombie (Risen)]] if {{PAGENAME}} is summoned before [[Zombie (Risen)]] is placed

== Summons: Abyssal Jellies ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' has the ability to summon Abyssal Jellies. 
<tabber>
|-|Abyssal Jelly=
'''Abyssal Jellies''' will be summoned on '''{{PAGENAME}}''''s SPA maxing out at 3. Abyssal Jellies have only 1 HP, but explode dealing a full AoE burst of Magic damage equal to {{PAGENAME}}'s damage on death. The range of this explosion is believed to be equivalent to {{PAGENAME}}'s range. Once an Abyssal Jelly dies, she will be put on cooldown for 1.5x her SPA and begin summoning another one afterwards.
</tabber>

{{Selling}}

==Trivia==
* Summons possess the same types {{PAGENAME}} has.
* Abyssal Jellies can break 2 shields due to the explosion they deal on contact.
* Her summons can be buffed by [[Zombie (Risen)]].
* {{PAGENAME}} will be put on cooldown if an Abyssal Jelly dies before she has summoned all three, causing her to only summon one.
* Since {{PAGENAME}} gets put on cooldown anytime an Abyssal Jelly dies, some strange situations can occur if she is on cooldown and another Abyssal Jelly dies:
# Her cooldown will be '''reset''', causing her to only start summoning the dead Abyssal Jellies after 1.5x her SPA at the time the '''second Abyssal Jelly died rather than the first'''.
# Her summoning can be '''canceled''' if an Abyssal Jelly dies as the animation is playing, causing no Abyssal Jelly to spawn once her animation ends.

When you activate his ability, he starts a hybrid attack that hits several times and multiplies his base damage depending on the amount of souls received. The attack deals Yamamoto's base damage, plus 2% damage for every soul consumed in the attack. If he consumes 50 souls, he would be doing 200% damage (100% damage + (50 x 2%) = 200%). At 500 souls, he does ''1100% damage or ''1,063,069.48'' damage with his manual ability.''

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades. 

==Trivia==
*It is recommended to use his ability if you are struggling to finish off strong flying enemies in his range, or to save the souls for when a strong boss without shields appears.
*Zanka no Tachi caps out at 500 souls (+1000% damage), and any kills past the 500 mark will not be counted for his next ability usage.
*He was obtainable as a 5% secret drop in Karakora Town [[Dungeons|The Fire]] dungeon. This was changed on 1/14/23.
*His shiny skin is based on the younger Yamamoto's appearance in the original series.

==Luck Bar==
{{PAGENAME}} is able to gain luck with every attack. From Upgrades 0-5, he will gain +5% luck per hit (with 1 hit). From Upgrades 6-8, he will gain +3.3% luck per hit (with 3 hits). Luck gained per hit has a chance to be tripled, scaling off his Crit Rate (50% chance to triple with 50% Crit Rate, 100% chance to triple with 100% Crit Rate). Upon reaching 100% luck, {{PAGENAME}}'s ability will activate Frenzy.

== Frenzy ==
Once activating {{PAGENAME}}'s ability with 100% luck, he will activate a frenzy for all units within his range (including himself). Frenzy will increase Crit Rate for Units in range by +50% (this does not work on True damage type units such as [[Umbra (Nuclear)]]) for 30 seconds with about a 32 seconds cooldown (No Global Cooldown).

== Selling ==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

== Trivia ==
*This is the first support unit to buff crit chance

*This is currently the only known way for magic damage units to critically hit.

*Although it is possible to maintain perfect uptime with Gambler at upgrade 0 and 3, it is very unreliable. Upgrade 6 is necessary for consistent uptime with Frenzy.

griffith:article.text:
==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} unit. He is only obtainable from [[Summon|summon]]. When you obtain Griffin you will automatically be rewarded the Periapt of the King.

{{EvolutionTable}}
{{Takedowns|7,500}}  

Additionally, he requires at least 100% Ascension in the Periapt of the King to evolve. 

== About Ascension ==
When one uses the Periapt of the King in the Items section of their inventory, they will be teleported to a domain. By talking to the Griffin (Fallen) NPC, the player will be immediately given the choice between [Ascend] and [Sacrifice]. If [Sacrifice] is selected, the player will be offered a choice between sacrificing Periapts of Sacrifice, which raises Ascension by 0.5% each, or sacrificing Mythic units, giving 4.2% for unevolved units and 8.4% for evolved units. Any Mythics can be sacrificed, including Griffin and his evolved variant. If [Ascend] is selected the inventory will pop up, prompting the player to pick the Griffin they want to evolve, consuming 100% of the Ascension stored. 

Do note that before sacrificing an eligible unit, one will be given a warning similar to that seen when sacrificing eligible units to the [[Supreme Being|Sovereign's Staff]].

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox|caption1="There is one thing I can do for them: it is to win and keep winning until I obtain my dream. My dream is already smeared with blood. I don’t regret, I don’t feel guilty, but I’d rather sacrifice myself than watch anymore innocent children die in the name of my dream."
|caption2="Even idols need a means to spread their reputation."
}}{{Main Stats}}

==Overview ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He can only be obtained by evolving [[Griffin]]. 

{{EvolutionTable}}

Additionally, he requires either 200 Eggs of Sacrifice or 24 {{Rarity|Mythical}} or 12 evolved {{Rarity|Mythical}}  units.

==Sacrifice==
<tabber>
|-|Griffin (Reincarnation)=
*[[Griffin (Reincarnation)]]​ -​ Sacrificed BUFF Types 
** Note that not all support units can be used for this variant. Unsellable units cannot be used for sacrifice. (e.g Idol and Idol (Idol) ).
**The percentage will show up in <font color="yellow">Yellow</font> if the unit was a BUFF type.
**The reincarnation variant's buff can be stacked with [[Blossom]], [[Idol (Star)]],  [[Commander]], [[Wenda]], and [[Elfy (Sylph)]]  buff.
**The reincarnation variant's buff stacks additively with all other buffs.
**The reincarnation variant needs a minimum of 100,000¥ to summon.

|-|Griffin (Darkness)=
* [[Griffin (Darkness)]]​ -​ Sacrifice non-BUFF Types
** The percentage will show up in <font color="red">Red</font> if the unit was a DAMAGE type.
** The darkness variant needs a minimum of 100,000¥ so 1 maxed out [[Hubris (The One)]] (without [[Idol (Star)]]) can summon instantly.
** The darkness variant's damage can be increased above the 100% threshold, the increase in dmg per !% extra is unknown currently due to the fact that it increases then at some specific percentage begins to decrease.
</tabber>

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost, However [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] cannot be sold.

==Trivia==
*Shiny Griffin appears as [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] in the lobby, instead of [[Griffin (Darkness)]] like normal.
*Before Update 17, the reincarnation variant costed a minimum of 30,000¥ to summon, and it used to stack multiplicatively with [[Commander]], [[Wind Dragon]], and [[Elfy (Sylph)]] buffs. This has since been increased to 100,000¥, and his buff now stacks additively to all other damage buffs.

femto:article.title: Griffin (Darkness)
femto:article.text:
{{Meta Unit}}
==Overview ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} This unit is a part of [[Griffin (Ascension)]], and it is activatеd by sacrificing non-buff units.  
==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox|caption1="I... sacrifice."
}}{{Main Stats}}

Attacks starting from Deployment are able to hit air type enemies.


==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.


==Disclaimer==
Upgrading Griffin (Darkness) can get very, very '''expensive''' depending on how many towers you sacrifice. It is '''heavily''' '''not recommended''' to sell him, as you will not be refunded yen from towers that you have sacrificed. '''Place. Him. Carefully.'''

==Sacrifice Condition==
Griffin (Darkness) is awakened from Griffin (Ascension) using non-buffing units using his ability. His ability deletes all units within his range and depending on the value of the units the percent he gains is higher. You gain 1% for each 1000¥ spent on sacrificed units.

Griffin's damage multiplier can be exactly calculated with the equation: dmg multi =(cost^0.47)/6.0714. A high percentage you can get is 2551% you can get this by using [[Berserker (Rage)]], [[Illusionist (Final)]], [[Stringy (Awakened)]], [[Golden Tyrant (Emperor)]], and [[Usurper (Founder)]]. With 2551% your Griffin (Darkness) can do 302,110 DPS (varies depending on stats and potential). With 2551%, Wenda, Griffin Reincarnation, and Pucci Heaven your Griffin Darkness will do 1,510,550 DPS. however this is not his max because [[Paradox (Divine Sight)]] can be given an infinite amount of upgrades because of limitless, just him to ''Limitless 10'' will give a total of 900k cost.

==Trivia==
* [[Idol (Star)]]'s ''cost reduction'' '''DOES''' affect how many percents you will get from sacrificing units. For example, sacrificing a fully-upgraded [[Millie (Holy)]] will give 96% to [[Griffin (Ascension)]] without [[Idol (Star)]]'s buff, while doing the same with ''20% cost reduction'' (fully-upgraded [[Idol (Star)]]) will only give 77%.
* The current percentage cap for this unit is ''unknown''. The more expensive the unit sacrificed, the more damage Griffin (Darkness) will gain. Therefore, theoretically, the unit's damage is infinite, as long as you have the money, time, and the appropriate unit(s) to sacrifice. Who knows when we will need a new [[:Category:Money Units|Money Unit]] to utilize this monster?
'''<u>How to get the most damage out of [[Griffin (Darkness)]]?</u>'''

# Get [[Griffin (Ascension)]]'s sacrifice meter to 95%+; you can, boost the meter up to 99% or even 100% (rounded of 99.5%-99.9%) but remember to calculate carefully since the unit will transform once it hits 100% and you will lose the opportunity to boost Griffin's damage further. (This unit is sellable but you will '''NOT''' be refunded) '''''(<u>Note</u>: 1k¥ spent on unit(s) = 1% sacrifice meter.)'''''
# Place and fully-upgrade '''ALL''' of your main damage dealing units within Griffin (Ascension)'s range.
# Hit the '''Sacrifice''' ability.

* In case you have brought [[Idol (Star)]] into the game and you still want to get Griffin (Darkness)'s damage as high as possible, you can copy the steps mentioned above; however, instead of placing [[Idol (Star)]] at the beginning of the game, you may want to place her when you have finished all the sacrificing. By doing this, not only will you still get the maximum damage possible (without the ''20% money discount''), you will also get the ''15% damage bonus'' from [[Idol (Star)]]'s passive ability!

Idol (Star) has the ability to lower the cost of upgrading your units and also give a Damage Boost to any of your units you place '''no matter where she is''' placed on the map.

* She is the first unit to have her banner version after debuting as a battlepass unit.

* As of Update 15, she, [[Blossom]], [[Skeleton (Soul King)]] and [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] are the only ones capable of buffing both Physical and Magical damage.
** She's the only one who can only affect the user's own units.
*From update 19.5, she can negate High Cost debuffs, which is not affected by High Cost stages and reduced the placement cost of other units to normal state.
* This is the first unit to be able to reduce upgrade costs, making her very useful for High Cost stages.
* Golden trait has cost reduction of 6% at deployment, 12% at upgrade 1, 18% at upgrade 2, 24% at upgrade 3.

* This is the first unit to have 2 shiny variants, one from the cake hunt battlepass and one from the banner

==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}}. He can only be obtained by evolving [[Izo (Black Fire)]].
He is also the boss of stage 5 of [[Raids#Storm Hideout|Storm Hideout]] in The Final Confrontation.
{{EvolutionTable}}
==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1=“People live their lives bound by what they accept as correct and true. That’s how they define ‘reality’. But what does it mean to be ‘correct’ or ‘true’? Merely vague concepts.”
|caption2="People’s lives don’t end when they die. It ends when they lose faith."
|image1={{PAGENAME}}.png
}}{{Main Stats}}

==Passive Ability: Black Flames==
Enemies can take more Burn DoT and he can deal 100% burn damage making his burn DPS very efficient. it's also really good for {{Damage Type|Fire}} Affinity Stages (weakness), or any stages with Ice enemies involved, such as Magic Town or Clover Kingdom.

However, it's worth noting that since half of his damage comes from burn, he isn't as effective against Regen enemies.  This is because burn damage is dealt over time; as a result, it gives Regen enemies time to heal.  Consider a Regen enemy with 2000 HP, an Itochi (Susanoo) that does 1000 damage plus 1000 burn, and a different character that does 2000 damage.  Since Itochi (Susanoo)'s burn occurs over time, the enemy would be able to regen and survive his attack.  On the other hand, the character that dealt the damage all at once would prevent regeneration from occurring.

With the [[Relics|Infernal Gaze]], his Burn Damage will be doubled and given his duration of 10 ticks (100% before the relic is applied), he would technically deal triple damage if including his normal damage. A max level {{PAGENAME}} can deal up to 660k+ damage with his burn, each burn dealing around 30k damage and also adding on the initial attack damage. His burn stacks with other burn units.

*The most efficient way to max out the damage gained by the '''''Slim Down''''' passive is by stopping at '''Upgrade 6;''' ''No Refunds'', as it buffs his damage by 1.8% every 5 seconds, as compared to '''Upgrade 8;''' ''Slim Down''<nowiki/>'s increase of 2% every 7.8 seconds, making '''Upgrade 6''' 44% ''faster'' than '''Upgrade 8''', assuming enemies are perpetually within this unit's range.

gojo_evolved:article.title: Paradox (Divine Sight)
gojo_evolved:article.text:
{{Infinity Castle Meta Unit}}{{Raid Meta Unit}}{{Meta Support Unit}}

==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable by evolving [[Paradox]]. 

{{EvolutionTable}}


==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1="Nah, I'd win."
|caption2=“The reason you're going to lose is because you didnt chop my head off.”
|image1={{PAGENAME}}.png
|image2={{PAGENAME}} Shiny.png
}}{{Main Stats}}

==Active Ability: Unlimited Void==
[[File:Paradox (Divine Sight) Passive.png|left|thumb|103x103px]]
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' Stops every enemy in their tracks and buffs his damage by 100% for the duration of his domain. If an enemy has already been affected by [[Effects#Timestop|Timestop]] less than 10 seconds before use, the enemy will not be stopped in the domain.
*Global Cooldown: 60
*Duration: 8

== Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
*For the {{Item|Six Eyes}}, you must get 6 Rikugan Eyes to form one.
*His upgrades' costs (not including Limitless upgrades) are the same as [[Trickster (Release)]].
*Limitless 1 costs 3 Rikugan Eyes, while all following Limitless upgrades require more and more Six Eyes (1 Six Eye for Limitless 2, 2 Six Eyes for Limitless 3, 4 Six Eyes for Limitless 4, 5 Six Eyes for Limitless 5, 8 Six Eyes for limitless 6, 12 Six eyes for limitless 7 etc.)
*Every Limitless upgrade increases Paradox's DMG by 10% of his DMG at Upgrade 9 and costs 1,400¥ more than the previous upgrade.
**Assuming a 50k {{PAGENAME}} at Upgrade 9, Limitless 1 would deal 55,000 (110%) and cost 15,400¥
**At Limitless 3, {{PAGENAME}} would deal 65k (130%) and the upgrade would cost 18,200¥
**At Limitless 6, {{PAGENAME}} would deal 80k (160%) and the upgrade would cost 22,400¥
**At Limitless 10, {{PAGENAME}} would deal 100k (200%) and the upgrade would cost 28,000¥
**Finally, at Limitless 15, {{PAGENAME}} would deal 126k (250%) and the upgrade would cost 35,000¥
*After Update 14.0.0, {{PAGENAME}} has been given the {{Damage Type|Aqua}} damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.

shanks_evolved:article.text:
==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He can only be obtained by evolving [[Red Scar]].

{{EvolutionTable}}

==Stats Overview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1="I'll leave this hat with [[Joykid|you]]. It's dear to me. Take good care of it! Come bring it back to me someday, once you've become a great pirate!"
|caption2="Listen up bandits! Whether I'm sprayed with alcohol, or doused with food, hell even if I'm spit on, most of the time ill just laugh it off and forget about it, but if you hurt a [[Joykid|friend]] of mine, you'll pay for it regardless of you're reason."

==Active Ability: Conqueror's Haki==
Shanks uses the Haoshoku Haki to make enemies in his range sleep/unconscious for 3 seconds with a cooldown of 15 seconds. This works against flying enemies as well.

This ability stacks with any other effects (stun, freeze, mind control) making it very useful for stalling enemies. (must be used 1 second after previous effect wears off)

|image1={{PAGENAME}}.png

==Active Ability: Gale of the Moon==
On placement [[Snow Reaper (Final)]] obtains a bar which fills up by 1.25 every half second, maxing out at 100.

At '''Upgrade 1''', {{PAGENAME}} unlocks the ability '''Gale of the Moon'''. While this ability is active, the bar will be drained by 2.5 every half second, enemies within her range are '''slowed''', take '''1/6th''' of her '''damage''' every half second and are inflicted with '''Chilled'''. Chilled enemies have an icon of a snowflake that freezes the enemy and deals an additional hit equal to her damage stat once it reaches 6. 

Pressing the ability again will deactivate it manually, or it will automatically deactivate if the bar reach to 0. 

== Selling ==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
*The snowflake icon disappears after 2 seconds. 
*Her ability counts as full AOE.
*If you wait for her ability to be at 100% and then let it drain till 0% she would have an additional dps of about 4.9k

{{Meta Unit}}

==Overview==
Supreme Being (Sovereign)  is a {{Rarity|Secret}} unit. Hе can only be obtained by evolving [[Supreme Being]]. 

{{EvolutionTable}}
{{Takedowns|7500}}

==Stats Ovеrview==
{{Tower_Infobox
|caption1="It does not matter if you are rich, a hero, or the common people. In death, everyone is equal."
|caption2=“Life and death are nothing more than states of being. To move someone between the two is a simple matter to one such as I.”
}}{{Main Stats}}
Attacks starting from Upgrade 7 are able to hit air type enemies.

==Passive Ability: Shade Birth==
Summons a Shade Birth after taking down 10 enemies (max 3), the Shade Birth will have 5x of his displayed damage. 

* [[Zombie (Risen)]] increases the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns in by 25% of each placement (up to 200%). Buffs to {{PAGENAME}} by Elfy (Slyph), Wind Dragon or Idol, do not affect the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns with.
* [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] and [[Commander]] increase the amount of damage Shade Birth does when colliding with an enemy.
* You can increase the damage the Shade Birth does by increasing {{PAGENAME}}'s base damage stats: having high [[Powerups|stat potential]], [[Traits]] that increase damage and [[Relics]].
* Shade Birth does not do Dark damage like {{PAGENAME}}, instead only doing physical.

==Active Ability: Nihilism==
[[File:Supreme Being (Sovereign) Passive.png|left|thumb|103x103px]]
Once Activated, a 12-second interval will appear above {{PAGENAME}}, once the time ticks down to zero, any enemy in the range of Supreme Being will take 5x of his damage, enemies who are caught by this also have a purple effect around them.


==Selling==
Unit sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
*He is the second {{Rarity|Secret}} unit added in the game that is not limited-time. The first unit being [[Lulu]].
*In the winter event his Shade Births have a spawn cap of 3 per path and thus can have 9 of them at the same time.
*Before update 18.5, he need at least 50 kills in order to summon a Shade Birth. From update 19.0, his passive requirement has been buff with only required 1 kill in order to summon.
**However from update 19.5, he has received a nerf, making his kill requirement into 10 kills in order to summon.

wendy:article.text: {{Meta Support Unit}} {{Story Meta Unit}} {{Raid Meta Unit}} =='''Overview'''== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. She is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]]. ==Stats Overview== {{Tower_Infobox |caption1="It's not about whether or not you're a human or an Exceed. We're all living beings and we have to do what is right. I'll be right beside you. There's nothing to be afraid of." |caption2="It's not about whether or not you're a human or an Exceed. We're all living beings and we have to do what is right. I'll be right beside you. There's nothing to be afraid of." |title1=Wind Dragon }}{{Main Stats}} ==Active Ability: Sky Enchantment== [[File:SkyEnchantmentIcon.png|thumb|left]] Sky Enchantment is available upon placement. When activated, Wenda increases the magical damage stats of units in her range by 30%. The buff lasts for 30 seconds and the ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds. When correctly placed down and timed correctly, she can buff units by 100%. =="Infinite" Buff Guide== Wind Dragon '''MUST BE CURSED''' with '''+SPA''' curse in order for this to work. '''ATTACK SPEED FROM STATS DO NOT MATTER AND DO NOT AFFECT ABILITY COOLDOWN.''' The percent shouldn't really matter, but depending on how high or low the increase might effect how long the loop will last. (Not exactly sure on the specifics yet.) Guide: *1. Place 4 Wind Dragon's, doesn't really matter the position as long as all they are all in each others range. *2. Activate the first Wind Dragon's ability, then wait 4-5 seconds. (Using an auto-clicker set to a 4-5 second interval can help if you are having trouble timing it.) *3. Activate a second Wind Dragon's ability. Then wait for the 25% buff to disappear. *4. As soon as the 30% disappears, immediately activate your third Wind Dragon's ability, then wait until the 69% buff to disappear. *5. As soon as the 69% disappears, immediately activate the your fourth Wind Dragon's ability. After this they should all loop 100% for a while, this loop isn't truly infinite since over time the ability will slowly desync, but if timed right can last for over 50 rounds, which is long enough for pretty much every situation. ==Selling== Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades. ==Trivia== *Before Update 7.6.0 (Karakora Town Event Part 2), she was a ground unit, meaning she could not be deployed on hill areas. *Before Update 12.0.0 (Cloud Hunt), her damage wasn't going up from her upgrades. As of this update, she currently has the highest DPS of all {{Rarity|Legendary}} tier units in the game, as her DPS on max upgrade is just as the same as [[Devil Boss]] on his max upgrade. *Before Update 14.0.0 (Sword Art Online): ** Her spawn cap was 3. Now it's 6, and global. *Chaining her buffs allows her to buff all magic units by 100%, although to consistently do this you may need to apply curses to her SPA to get this to a full uptime, this also applies to [[Commander]] ==Gallery== __NOTOC__ __NOEDITSECTION__ {{Unit Navigation}} [[Category:Legendary Units]]
